newsitem.title: UK: Redland shares climb, NatWest said positive.
newsitem.headline: Redland shares climb, NatWest said positive.

text.p: Shares in Redland Plc climbed on Friday after NatWest Securities restated its positive stance on the stock, dealers said.
By 0928 GMT, Redland shares were 12p higher at 346 on volume of two million.
"NatWest has been tipping the share as a recovery play. There is also some talk around it could be a bid target," the head of trading at a large investment bank said.
Analysts at NatWest Securities were not immediately available for comment.
"Redland have been meeting a few analysts recently and giving them a reasonable picture and NatWest seem to be pushing the stock on that basis," one market-maker said.
